notes.title: Who Made This Update New Case 5
notes.notes:
Hello detectives!

A new mystery comes to you, case 5 "The Case of a Thousand Locks"

Who was it? What happened? It's time to investigate! Have fun!

Other information:

We are working on optimizing the game's graphics and new mechanics in the future.

notes.title: Released!
notes.notes:
The new game from BRUNOARTS Entertainment is now available!

Have fun with the first 4 cases of the new investigation game, easy and fun to play. How long will it take you to solve the mysteries?!

The idea is to create a competition between detectives from all over the world. Share how long it took you to solve the cases!

Coming soon:

The next updates should be available in the coming weeks, with new mysteries, a time ranking and many other new features in the future.

The game will also be available for Android phones! Stay tuned!

Have fun everyone!
